record_purpose: Record the R4 source slice that blocks release publication until a versioned, digest-bound candidate gate map is complete. This file is an enforcement receipt, not an instance of the lapis-release-candidate-gates gate map that release consumes; it carries no gates, so release --candidate-gate-map must never be pointed at it.

source.review_repair_state: The eight PR #88 review repairs were applied as a dirty working tree on the named committed baseline. The complete dirty-file set and hashes below bind the validated bytes; the follow-up commit preserves them.

scope: This receipt covers source enforcement and focused Python checks only. It does not build, verify, notarize, package, publish, download, install, or qualify a candidate.
implementation: Package manifest candidate gate-map schema 1 requires downloaded-asset, notarized staged verification, fresh-user Finder launch, installed Sparkle update with live sessions, update-failure recovery, and registry/history migration rollback receipts.

Each gate binds source revision, version, app and DMG artifact hashes, the applicable appcast digest where required, the receipt digest and path inside the map, a UTC timestamp in any ISO 8601 form that resolves to UTC, a command, zero exit status, and a passing scope. The bound map also records its own byte digest.

The appcast field is named appcast_digest because it carries the release manifest digest() of the appcast, which binds the file name and structure as well as its bytes; receipts bind raw bytes separately via content_sha256 under receipt_sha256.

Release accepts --candidate-gate-map, stages the appcast and gate bindings into one temporary copy of the manifest, and swaps it in with a single atomic replace, so a rejected gate map never leaves a manifest carrying an appcast binding with no candidate approval.
Replacing covered app or DMG bytes, weakening notarization, or rebinding the appcast revokes gate approval while retaining prior receipts as evidence.

bind_candidate_gates refuses to overwrite an existing binding by default; replace=True is the explicit operator escape hatch for re-binding during candidate iteration, and it revalidates the complete replacement before writing.
Final preflight rejects missing, malformed, failed, stale, unbound, or receipt-digest-mismatched gates.
